model_routing.rule: The orchestrator MUST prefix all subagent prompts with the header '[MODEL: yolo]' or '[MODEL: gemini-3.5-flash]' when calling invoke_subagent. The runtime router will parse this header to execute the subagent on the yolo model, ensuring no subagent runs on the same model as the orchestrator.
